head.definition: The upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals.
head.exampleUsage: The head was identified during the lesson.

skull.definition: The bony skeleton of the head of vertebrates.

scalp.definition: The skin that covers the top of the head.

temple.definition: The flat area on either side of the forehead.

crown.definition: The part of a tooth above the gum that is covered with enamel.

forehead.definition: The large cranial bone forming the front part of the cranium: includes the upper part of the orbits.

jaw.definition: The part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth.

chin.definition: The protruding part of the lower jaw.

neck.definition: The part of an organism (human or animal) that connects the head to the rest of the body.
neck.exampleUsage: The neck was identified during the lesson.

throat.definition: The passage to the stomach and lungs.

eye.definition: Good discernment (either visually or as if visually).

eyebrow.definition: The arch of hair above each eye.

eyelid.definition: Either of two folds of skin that can be moved to cover or open the eye.

eyelash.definition: Any of the short curved hairs that grow from the edges of the eyelids.

pupil.definition: The contractile aperture in the center of the iris of the eye.

iris.definition: Muscular diaphragm that controls the size of the pupil which in turn controls the amount of light that enters the eye.

retina.definition: The innermost light-sensitive membrane covering the back wall of the eyeball.

cornea.definition: The transparent dome-shaped anterior portion of the outer covering of the eye.

tear-duct.definition: A blocked tear duct prevents tears from draining into the nose, leaving the eyes unusually watery.
tear-duct.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «تيار دوكت»

eye-socket.definition: The bony cavity in the skull that contains and protects the eye, also called the orbit.
eye-socket.exampleUsage: The eye sits within the bony eye socket.

nose.definition: The organ of smell and entrance to the respiratory tract.

nostril.definition: Either one of the two external openings to the nasal cavity in the nose.

bridge-of-nose.definition: The upper firm part of the nose between the eyes.
bridge-of-nose.exampleUsage: The glasses rest partly on the bridge of the nose.

mouth.definition: The externally visible part of the oral cavity on the face and the system of organs surrounding the opening.

lip.definition: Either the outer margin or the inner margin of the aperture of a gastropod's shell.

upper-lip.definition: The upper of the two soft edges surrounding the mouth.
upper-lip.exampleUsage: The upper lip lies below the nose.

lower-lip.definition: The lower of the two soft edges surrounding the mouth.
lower-lip.exampleUsage: The lower lip forms the bottom edge of the mouth.

tongue.definition: The muscular part of the mouth used for tasting, speaking, and swallowing.

palate.definition: The upper surface of the mouth that separates the oral and nasal cavities.

gums.definition: The soft tissue around the teeth in the mouth.

ear.definition: The body part used to hear sounds and help with balance.

earlobe.definition: The fleshy pendulous part of the external human ear.

ear-canal.definition: A narrow passage in the outer ear carries sound from the auricle to the eardrum.
ear-canal.arabicTranslation: مصطلح طبي أو تشريحي يُسمّى «يار كانال»

eardrum.definition: The membrane in the ear that vibrates to sound.
eardrum.exampleUsage: The glossary uses the term "Eardrum" in an educational description.

inner-ear.definition: The deepest region of the ear contains the cochlea for hearing and structures that control balance.

outer-ear.definition: The visible part of the ear gathers sound and carries it into the middle ear. In people, it mainly includes the auricle, or outer flap, and the ear canal.

hearing.definition: The ability to notice and understand sounds.

sound-wave.definition: A mechanical wave, meaning a moving disturbance that needs matter to travel, carries alternating regions of pressure through a material and can produce hearing in humans and other animals.
sound-wave.exampleUsage: The sound wave was identified during the lesson.

balance.definition: Harmonious arrangement or relation of parts or elements within a whole (as in a design).

cochlea.definition: The snail-shaped tube (in the inner ear coiled around the modiolus) where sound vibrations are converted into nerve impulses by the organ of Corti.

tooth.definition: Toothlike structure in invertebrates found in the mouth or alimentary canal or on a shell.

incisor.definition: A tooth for cutting or gnawing.

canine.definition: Of or relating to a pointed conical tooth.

molar.definition: Of or pertaining to the grinding teeth in the back of a mammal's mouth.
molar.exampleUsage: The molar was identified during the lesson.

premolar.definition: A tooth having two cusps or points.

wisdom-tooth.definition: One of the last adult molar teeth at the back of the mouth, usually appearing in late adolescence or early adulthood.
wisdom-tooth.exampleUsage: The dental X-ray showed the position of a wisdom tooth.

baby-tooth.definition: An early tooth that serves a young child until a permanent tooth grows in and replaces it.

enamel.definition: Hard white substance covering the crown of a tooth.

root.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water.

hair.definition: A covering for the body (or parts of it) consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures (as on the human head).

hairline.definition: The natural margin formed by hair on the head.

part.definition: A line of scalp that can be seen when sections of hair are combed in opposite directions.

strand.definition: A necklace made by stringing objects together.

beard.definition: The hair growing on the lower part of a man's face.

mustache.definition: An unshaved growth of hair on the upper lip.

sideburns.definition: Facial hair that has grown down the side of a man's face in front of the ears (especially when the rest of the beard is shaved off).

stubble.definition: Material consisting of seed coverings and small pieces of stem or leaves that have been separated from the seeds.

goatee.definition: A small chin beard trimmed to a point.

braid.definition: To form or weave into a braid or braids.
